item.title: Monday 1 PM Update, Nov 9
item.description:
The Monday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 9, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Representative Massie files to force a House vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth, who plans a rare press conference; Trump meets Qatar's prime minister on Iran as oil falls; two arrests and a brief lockdown near the White House; Europeans press Secretary Rubio at the G7 in Paris; who's coming to the Abu Dhabi talks; stocks surge at midday while Nvidia lags; AST SpaceMobile's satellite venture with Rakuten in Japan; OpenAI hires Hacktron to probe its own systems, and a sobering coding-agent test; a cloud supply-chain attack through Qubole, a hijacked crypto developer tool, and Treasury's move against the MEXC exchange; your X feed; New Hampshire's first Black state senator-elect and the Lancers' strong finish; and glowworms back in Yorkshire. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 10 AM Update, Nov 9
item.description:

item.title: Monday Morning, Nov 9
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
